hero.subtitle: Tell us where you want to go and how much you can set aside. Coti tells you how long it takes — and stays with you until you get there.
hero.note: Coti projects, it doesn't book: no flight search, no hotel quotes, no payments.

story.title: From the dream to the savings box, and from the box to the destination

dream.title: Dream the destination
dream.text: Pick where and when. Coti gives you a credible range in pesos, not an exact quote.

save.title: Save in your box
save.text: Set how much you can put aside each payday. Every entry adds up and progress is visible and celebrated.

arrive.title: Arrive
arrive.text: When the box reaches the goal, the trip stops being a distant idea. You decide how to book it.

projection.title: Your trip may cost between $28,000 and $34,000 MXN.
projection.text: That's how Coti talks: in ranges, with assumptions in plain sight and no guaranteed-savings promises. Let's adjust the plan to get there.

project.title: Project, don't book
project.text: Credible ranges; no flights, hotels or payments.

value.title: Value before data
value.text: You get an estimate before sharing your finances.

company.title: Visible support
company.text: Progress and milestones that sustain the habit for months.

product.title: From destination to savings box in eight steps
product.text: No endless forms, no promises. Pick where, how you travel and what you want to do; Coti projects the range, you set the pace and the box does the rest.

projection.note: Estimated range by season and style. Coti projects, it doesn't book.
